cross_cutting_memory.subconscious: A light preconscious scorer may emit bounded priors/biases but must not make final decisions.
cross_cutting_memory.survive: Safety/liveness degradation must be explicit; no silent partial success.

hunt_chaos_survive.law: No one pressure may silently dominate; a dominance cap and safety override are required.

cross_cutting_memory.failure_memory: Failures, timeouts and canary/circuit-breaker evidence are first-class memory and should influence future routing without being rewritten as negative proof.
